routerUser.name: Router Username
routerUser.description: The administrator username used to log into your ASUS router.

routerIp.name: Router IP Address
routerIp.description: The local IP address of your ASUS router (e.g., 192.168.50.1).

routerSshPort.name: SSH Port
routerSshPort.description: The port configured for SSH access on your router (default is 22).

rsaPrivateKeyPath.name: Private Key Path
rsaPrivateKeyPath.description: The path relative to your Home Assistant /config folder pointing to your private SSH key.

certFilePathOnRouter.name: Certificate Path on Router
certFilePathOnRouter.description: The absolute path where the DDNS SSL certificate (.pem) is stored on the router.

keyFilePathOnRouter.name: Key Path on Router
keyFilePathOnRouter.description: The absolute path where the DDNS private key (.pem) is stored on the router.

statusHelper.name: Status Helper Entity (input_text)
statusHelper.description: (Optional) The full entity ID of the input_text helper (e.g., input_text.router_cert_version) to be updated when a new certificate is fetched. Leave blank if you do not want to track status updates.
